description: This file defines Data Access Object (DAO) classes for handling database operations related to SQL queries and saved queries within the Superset project. It includes methods for saving query metadata, retrieving queries changed after a certain timestamp, and stopping queries by client ID.

classes.name: QueryDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object for Query model, providing methods to save metadata, retrieve changed queries, and stop queries.

classes.name: SavedQueryDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object for SavedQuery model, extending base DAO functionalities.

methods.name: save_metadata
methods.description: Extracts relevant data from payload and stores it in the query's extra_json, particularly handling columns information.

methods.name: get_queries_changed_after
methods.description: Retrieves a list of queries that have changed after a specified timestamp.

methods.name: stop_query
methods.description: Attempts to stop a query identified by client_id, updating its status and end_time if successful.
